title: Monkey holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="balloonGrad" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b8a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e01a3a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bodyGrad" cx="45%" cy="40%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c8832a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8b5a1e"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="faceGrad" cx="45%" cy="40%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f0c070"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d4a055"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M 68 22 Q 72 35 66 50 Q 62 58 60 65" stroke="#9b6b3e" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="16" rx="13" ry="15" fill="url(#balloonGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="11" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#ff9db0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points="68,30 70,34 66,34" fill="#c41030"/>

  <!-- Monkey tail -->
  <path d="M 30 82 Q 18 78 16 68 Q 14 58 22 56 Q 28 55 28 62" stroke="#8b5a1e" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Monkey arms -->
  <!-- Left arm (holding string) -->
  <path d="M 42 68 Q 50 62 58 65 Q 62 66 60 68" stroke="#a06a28" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d="M 44 68 Q 36 65 32 70" stroke="#a06a28" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Monkey body -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="76" rx="16" ry="14" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="78" rx="9" ry="9" fill="#e8b86a"/>

  <!-- Monkey legs -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8b5a1e"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8b5a1e"/>

  <!-- Monkey head -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="54" r="16" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="48" r="6" fill="#a06a28"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="48" r="3.5" fill="#e8b86a"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="48" r="6" fill="#a06a28"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="48" r="3.5" fill="#e8b86a"/>

  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="57" rx="12" ry="10" fill="url(#faceGrad)"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="52" r="3" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="52" r="3" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="51" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="51" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="58" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#8b5a1e"/>
  <circle cx="38.5" cy="58" r="0.8" fill="#6a4010"/>
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="58" r="0.8" fill="#6a4010"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M 35 62 Q 40 66 45 62" stroke="#6a4010" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="58" r="3" fill="#e88080" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="3" fill="#e88080" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
